//! Probe: one call to each prohibited process-environment API.
//!
//! Materialized into a temporary directory and compiled by `clippy-driver`
//! with `CLIPPY_CONF_DIR` pointed at the workspace root, so the repository's
//! own `clippy.toml` decides the outcome. Exactly six diagnostics must come
//! back, each carrying its configured reason string.

pub fn reads() {
    let _ = std::env::var("WILDSIDE_PROBE");
    let _ = std::env::var_os("WILDSIDE_PROBE");
    let _ = std::env::vars();
    let _ = std::env::vars_os();
}

pub fn writes() {
    // SAFETY: the probe is never executed; it exists only to be linted.
    unsafe {
        std::env::set_var("WILDSIDE_PROBE", "1");
        std::env::remove_var("WILDSIDE_PROBE");
    }
}
